name: Charity fundraiser
summary: Run a charity fundraiser with an ask schedule, update posts and a thank-you list.

onboarding.prompt: Tap times for asks and updates.

phases.name: Set up
actions: Confirm the charity and giving page

plan_blueprint.calendar: Ask slots, weekly update posts, the event date, and a thank-you session afterwards.

approach_variants.habit: Two or three asks a day at the same time; streak of ask days.
approach_variants.willpower: Matching challenge with a friend or sponsor and a countdown to the event.
approach_variants.time: Asks, posts and thank-yous each get a calendar block; weekly review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward at 25%, 50% and 100% of the target.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers the cause story, photos, the giving page and the ask list.

guardrails: Use the charity's official giving page; GoalKin does not collect donations.
Donor names and amounts stay private unless each donor agrees to be thanked publicly.
Amounts raised start private; share the percent or turn on the amount when you choose.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed asks roll into the next week's list.
